title: A wage that resists falling
hook: Two stated cases: explore the sign of a wage relative to a reference.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the sign of a wage relative to a reference affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Value, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the sign of a wage relative to a reference in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
